title: Social content
summary: Creates organic social content for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok or Facebook: posts, threads, carousels and calendars.
benefit: Posts, threads and content calendars get drafted for each platform.
solves: Posting rarely or blandly because every post starts from a blank page.
use_cases: "Write a LinkedIn post about X", or an X thread, an Instagram carousel or a short video script.
"Turn this blog post into social content": one piece becomes posts for each platform.
"Plan my content for the week": a calendar per day and platform.
It reads your product marketing notes and brand file first, if the repo has them.
Posting on X: it uses the ranking signals from the open-sourced feed algorithm.
details: Ask for social content and this skill gathers your goals, audience and brand voice, then helps create LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok or Facebook posts, threads, carousels, short video scripts and content calendars, with platform strategies and limits in its reference files. It is for people building an audience or posting build-in-public updates. It adds a skill folder that loads only when used; instructions only, so no code runs on its own.
risk: Instructions only; loads when used. No code runs on its own.
